summary: Amer Sports, Inc., a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting that Tak Yan (Dennis) Tao resigned from its board on October 16, 2026, without disagreement, and that the board immediately appointed Shaoxiang (Eric) Ding as director; Wei Lin joined the Compensation Committee. Ding chairs Descente (China), an ANTA Sports joint venture, and is the son of board chairman Shizhong Ding. Terms are absent. Watch related-party governance and ANTA influence rather than deal mechanics.
